product_one_liner.value: Bitly is a link-management and marketing platform for businesses and individuals to create, share, customize, and track short links and QR Codes, with analytics and related digital engagement tools.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes products for creating, sharing, and tracking links and QR Codes.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Free, Core, Growth, Premium, and custom-priced Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in Bitly customer stories/case-study titles.

employee_band.notes: Published company profiles place Bitly within the 201–500 band; current headcount estimates also fall within it.

hq_location.notes: Company profiles identify New York as the headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Several substantive engineering-authored posts discuss engineering tools, language choice, and integration architecture, meeting the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The developer portal includes multiple API guides and tutorials, and Bitly also has a multi-article Help Center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Could not locate a verifiable current Bitly careers board or live role listings, so neither a negative nor positive hiring claim is supported.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Bitly's AI announcement and public Trust Center; they describe ChatGPT/plugin and MCP integrations but do not identify a model provider used by the Bitly product itself.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center explicitly says SOC 2 compliant and GDPR compliant. It additionally mentions Swiss-US Privacy Shield, which is not one of the five requested categories.

value.stage: growth equity/majority investment (round stage not specified)

last_funding.notes: Spectrum Equity's $63 million investment was announced July 12, 2017; reporting calls it additional funding and a majority-stake transaction, without specifying a conventional round label.

raised_18mo.notes: The last located funding announcement is from July 2017, well before the window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current official Bitly job board or live job postings could be verified; cannot conclude no SDR/AE role is open.

launched_6mo.notes: Bitly announced on October 20, 2026 that its Bitly GPT was becoming a ChatGPT plugin, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young's appointment as CTO on March 19, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Bitly's integration directory visibly lists both HubSpot and Salesforce.
